messages.weekly.title: Weekly trends
messages.weekly.intro: New maps, returns and durations in weeks starting on Monday. Select a map type to compare the same content.
messages.weekly.method: Pace counts new maps of the selected type per hour of all observed playtime in that week. Playtime and area breakdowns are shared by all types. Means and medians are computed for each weekly slice, rather than averaged from daily values.
messages.weekly.boundaries: A partial week is clipped by the report range or the outer observation dates; this does not measure log completeness. Empty weeks between observations remain visible. Zero new maps with measured playtime differs from no measurements. Eligible and excluded instances are shown; fewer than two complete measurements is marked as a small sample.
messages.weekly.zones_note: Times and shares cover measured visits to all areas during this week. Transitions and other parts of total playtime are not attributed to areas. Shares use the sum of measured area time.
messages.weekly.undated: Undated instances not assigned to weeks: {count}. They remain in the overall report.
messages.weekly.empty: No dates are available for weekly trends.
messages.weekly.chart.rate: New maps per hour of playtime
messages.weekly.active: Days with measured time: {count}; days in range: {days}
messages.weekly.no_previous: There is no preceding week in the selected range.
messages.weekly.partial_comparison: One of these weeks is partial; its range is shorter than seven days.
messages.heatmap.title: Playtime by weekday and hour
messages.heatmap.hint: Hours run horizontally and weekdays vertically. Colour shows total measured time. Hover over an active cell or focus it with the keyboard; select it to reveal dates linked to the calendar.
messages.heatmap.empty: No measured time for this filter.
messages.heatmap.method: All playtime includes observed play intervals, including transitions and AFK. Area filters use measured parts of visits. Intervals are split by local hours within the selected period; elapsed time is measured in UTC. A repeated hour during a clock change accumulates in one cell; a skipped hour receives no time. Days without positive measurements are excluded from active-day counts. Shared log copies count once; independent continuations remain separate.
messages.heatmap.special_note: Special areas use the same catalogue as the Special areas section, excluding acts, regular maps and hideouts. Boss maps may occur in both filters; filter totals should not be added together. Missing visit boundaries are not inferred.
messages.search.title: Search history
messages.search.scope: Search all {count} lines of the combined log, including messages outside the summary period.
messages.search.hint: Case-insensitive substring search in original messages, field values and rule codes. Dates are inclusive in the report time zone; undated lines are excluded when dates are selected. Results follow the full history order.
messages.search.ready: Enter a query or select filters, then press Search. An empty query shows all lines.
messages.search.cancelled: Search stopped. Press Search to start again.
messages.search.invalid: The start date must not be later than the end date.
messages.search.error: Part of the report could not be read. Keep the entire report folder and try the search again.
messages.search.open: Open line {line} in the full log
messages.search.needs_js: Search requires JavaScript. You can open the full history using the link below.
messages.sessions.title: Play sessions
messages.sessions.no_maps: No confirmed map entries in this session.
messages.sessions.zones_note: Areas within the selected part of this session.
messages.sessions.empty: No observed play sessions in the selected period.
messages.sessions.search: Find a session by date or time
messages.sessions.no_events: No selected key events in this session.
messages.sessions.history: Session start in the full log
messages.sessions.method: A session starts at an observed area entry. A graceful game exit or disconnection confirms its ending. A new log, clock regression, missing boundary time, end of file or a gap in records over 30 minutes ends observations without confirming an exit. Missing records do not prove absence of play; time after the last record is not inferred. Midnight does not split a session.
messages.sessions.branches_note: If a copied beginning has different continuations, its shared part is counted once and independent continuations separately. Summed measurements may exceed the time between the first and last observations; original endings are available in the session details.
messages.sessions.scope_note: The summary uses the selected period. Maps count reconstructed instances; re-entries appear separately. Area time includes measured portions only. Loading durations are shown separately and are not added to playtime. Death messages do not establish the log owner's personal deaths.
messages.sessions.pdf_note: Session summary. Maps, areas, events, and links to source records are available on the session pages in HTML.
messages.ui.independent_project_notice: An independent, non-commercial project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Grinding Gear Games. Game materials belong to their respective owners.
messages.ui.a_clock_regression_means_a_timestamp_: . A clock regression means a timestamp decreased between adjacent dated log lines; the cause is unknown.
messages.ui.their_duration_is_excluded_from_the_t: . Unmeasured portions are excluded from the total.
messages.ui.this_day_contains_log_lines_but_none_: This day contains log lines, but none of the selected event types.
messages.ui.includes_maps_hideouts_towns_transiti: Includes maps, hideouts, towns, transitions and AFK.
messages.ui.unknown_lines_in_the_full_history: Unknown lines in the full history:
messages.ui.selected_messages_without_their_own_d: Selected messages without their own date:
messages.ui.there_are_no_measured_play_intervals_: There are no measured play intervals for the chart yet.
messages.ui.how_to_read_the_timeline_and_what_it_: How to read the timeline and what it includes
messages.ui.no_maps_with_a_known_date_yet: No maps with a known date yet.
messages.ui.code_and_brief_description_follow_a_l: Type blocks and rules within them are sorted alphabetically. Follow a rule link for its exact format and fields.
messages.ui.insufficient_identifiers_repeated_ent: Insufficient identifiers: repeated entries are not merged.
messages.ui.no_days_to_display_undated_lines_rema: No days to display. Undated lines remain in the analysis ledger.
messages.ui.no_confirmed_entries_into_supported_m: No confirmed entries into supported maps. An entry requires area generation followed by an entry message.
messages.ui.campaign_and_endgame_areas_towns_and_: Campaign and endgame areas, towns and hideouts. Maps and boss arenas are counted separately.
messages.ui.confirmed_copied_history_is_counted_o: Confirmed copied history is counted once.
messages.ui.x_axis_days_y_axis_hours_exact_values: X axis: days. Y axis: hours. Exact values are listed in the table below.
messages.ui.from_area_entry_to_disconnection_at_e: From area entry to disconnection. At end of file or a gap over 30 minutes, time is counted only up to the last record; no continuation is assumed.
messages.ui.days_are_on_the_horizontal_axis_daily: Days are on the horizontal axis; daily hours played are on the vertical axis. Sessions crossing midnight are split between days. Hover over a bar to see its duration. Click a bar to open that day in the calendar.
messages.ui.no_conversations_in_the_recognized_pa: No conversations in the recognized part of the log.
messages.ui.no_evidence_of_technical_issues_found: No evidence of technical issues found.
messages.ui.all_lines_and_bytes_are_accounted_for: All lines and bytes are accounted for.
messages.ui.groups_this_page_collects_client_erro: groups. This page collects client errors and warnings, explicit signs of crashes, and log reading errors. Normal shutdown and exception handler registration are not treated as crashes.
messages.ui.conversations_private_messages_are_gr: conversations. Private messages are grouped by character name; channel messages are grouped by channel.
messages.ui.events_area_transitions_character_eve: events: area transitions, character events, trading and technical issues.

messages.position.approximate: Entry and exit times unknown; approximate position

messages.diagnostic.unframed: Line without a recognized header or continuation
messages.framing.blank: Exactly empty text after removing LF/CRLF; whitespace-only text does not match.
messages.framing.log.open: Log opening marker; time is retained in timestamp_raw/timestamp.
messages.framing.header.only: The header was parsed, but no message rule matched the text.
messages.framing.unclassified: No confirmed header or expected continuation.
messages.framing.encoding.utf8: The line cannot be decoded as UTF-8; original bytes are retained and text is absent.
messages.framing.timestamp: A header was found, but its date is invalid or its time is ambiguous/nonexistent in the selected zone. The pattern only validates shape.

messages.field.name: Name
messages.field.speaker: Speaker
messages.field.title: Title
messages.stats.no_maps: No confirmed map entries in the loaded logs.
messages.stats.no_zones: No confirmed zone visits in the loaded logs.
messages.stats.area_visits: Area, town and hideout visit history
messages.stats.map_note: Map count covers individual runs. Confirmed re-entries into the same instance belong to one run; visits are shown separately. These are entries, not completed maps.
messages.stats.time_note: Visits with known entry and exit times are summed, including AFK. Incomplete visits have unknown duration; a dash means no measurements. Locations with the most time appear first.
messages.stats.zone_note: Total time in each zone during the report period: maps, arenas, areas, towns and hideouts. Loading time and intervals with unknown location are excluded, so the sum can differ from overall playtime.
messages.stats.calendar_difference: Why can time differ from the calendar?
messages.stats.calendar_note: Measured visits within incomplete runs are included here. The calendar sums only fully measured runs, so its total may be lower.
messages.stats.daily_zone_note: Time in each zone within the selected day in the report timezone. A visit crossing midnight is counted on each affected day, with its time split between them. An incomplete visit is assigned to its entry date without a duration; visits with an undated entry are shown separately under unknown date.
messages.stats.no_daily_zones: No dated zone visits are available for this day.
messages.stats.maps_started_on_day: Map runs starting on this day
messages.stats.undated_zones: Visits with an unknown entry date
messages.stats.undated_zone_note: These visits cannot be assigned to a particular day. Their duration is not calculated; an exit time does not replace an unknown entry.
messages.timeline.calendar_hint: Select a day to open its timeline. Days with unknown lines or errors are also available.
messages.event.screen.microtransaction_converted: Item successfully converted to an account-bound microtransaction.
messages.event.screen.phrase.heart_desire: Your heart's desire, drenched in blood.
messages.event.screen.phrase.water_motion: Water without motion is but death in disguise.
messages.event.screen.phrase.thrill_void: Feel the thrill of the void!
messages.event.screen.phrase.conqueror: What divides the conqueror from the conquered?
messages.event.screen.phrase.room_quiet: The room grows still and quiet...
messages.characters.note: Characters with recorded level-up messages. Missing levels are not reconstructed. Other players may appear here. Identical names are grouped: logs may not distinguish recreated characters.
messages.characters.chart_hint: Hover over a line to see the day. Points show recorded level-ups and open the event; dashed lines only connect observations.
messages.characters.empty: No level-up messages with known timestamps were found.
messages.activities.intro: Time and visits across game areas during the report period. Related subzones are shown separately with a shared group total.
messages.activities.chart_note: All groups share one time axis. A bar is a known interval; a translucent marker shows entry only when duration is unknown. Short intervals are drawn at least 1.5 pixels wide; hover for exact times. Select a bar to open its entry event.
messages.activities.empty: No visits to these areas with known entry times.
messages.activities.scope: Groups do not overlap: each visit belongs to one subzone. The separate Delve row includes other mine biomes and arenas, excluding Azurite Mine. Bosses within Sanctum, Labyrinth and Delve stay in those groups; standalone arenas belong to Boss areas. Maps, hideouts and acts are counted separately.
messages.characters.range_empty: No recorded level-ups in this range.
messages.diagnostics.hint: Expand a category to see unrecognized messages. Exact repeats are grouped; line numbers refer to the merged history.
messages.diagnostics.no_text: The line cannot be decoded as UTF-8; text is unavailable.
messages.observations.title: Log counters
messages.observations.note: Sums of LOADING SCREEN durations and counts from Item(s) identified messages for the displayed period. Confirmed copies are excluded. Loads without durations and identifications without messages are not counted. Loading time is shown separately and is not added to playtime again.
messages.diagnostics.unknown_reason: The line does not match known rules
messages.diagnostics.message_reason: The header was parsed but the message content was not recognized
messages.catalogue.RELIQUARY_AREAS: Special Reliquary area IDs and names
messages.pdf.title: Play report · Path of Exile
messages.pdf.scope: Print summary: maps, time by day and area, special areas and character levels. Detailed events, conversations, diagnostics and rule specifications are available in the HTML report.
messages.pdf.activity_note: Weekly timeline: dates on the horizontal axis, minor ticks every 6 hours. All area groups share one chart. Pale marks indicate entries with unknown duration; short visits have a minimum visible width.
messages.pdf.character_note: Points are recorded level-ups; lines connect observations without reconstructing missing levels. Exact dates are listed in the table.
messages.history.scope: Complete sequential view of the merged log: {count} lines. Includes technical messages, chat, continuations, empty lines and errors. Confirmed copies are counted once. Line order is preserved; missing timestamps are not inferred. Select a message to reveal its original text and fields.
messages.history.parent: Go to the start of the message
messages.history.boundary_note: Start of an independent log segment.
messages.characters.delta_note: Elapsed time is measured from the previous observed level, including time offline. Repeated levels do not restart the interval; a level decrease does. Gaps cover the whole interval between recorded levels.
messages.pdf.heat_note: Daily duration colours: 0 h · under 2 h · 2–4 h · 4–8 h · 8 h or more.
messages.pdf.activity_overview_note: All area groups share a timeline covering the entire period. Gaps without visits are preserved. Pale marks indicate entries with unknown duration; short visits have a minimum visible width. Detailed weekly charts follow.
messages.flow.observations_note: A tag indicates NPC dialogue during this map visit; select it to open the original event. No tag does not mean the mechanic was absent. Death messages may refer to other characters.
messages.event.screen.nameless_seer: The Nameless Seer has appeared nearby
messages.event.screen.reflecting_mist: A Reflecting Mist has manifested nearby
messages.counters.title: /kills and /deaths samples
messages.counters.note: Each row is a cumulative value displayed by the game, not an increase. These messages do not name a character: values are neither added together nor assigned to a character from nearby dialogue. Rows follow the merged log order.
messages.map_observations.title: Map mechanics and special observations
messages.map_observations.note: Counts refer to maps with recognized observations, not completed mechanics, victories or rewards. A missing message does not prove a mechanic was absent.
messages.map_observations.method: Each map counts once for each observation type. Confirmed returns and copied log prefixes do not increase the map count. Matching names or seeds alone are insufficient: possible repeats with incomplete identity stay separate. Days and months use the first map entry in the report time zone; observations on later returns belong to that same date. Unknown dates appear separately. A map can have several observation types, so adding their counts does not give the number of maps.
messages.map_observations.open_hint: Select a count to open the maps and supporting log lines.
messages.map_observations.empty: These maps have no recognized observations.
messages.period.title: Report period
messages.period.note: Both dates are inclusive in the log time zone. Durations are clipped to these dates. Maps with visits in the period are counted, including visits that began earlier. Clipped boundaries do not imply a new entry or exit. Records without a determinable date are excluded from period statistics.
messages.period.change: To change the period, select dates in the application and generate the report again.
messages.period.context: This page retains the full history as source context. Summaries and PDF are limited to the selected period.
messages.period.mechanics: Only evidence within the selected dates is counted. Each map is grouped by its first included visit; intervals are clipped at period boundaries. Confirmed returns and copied entry lines count once; multiple tags must not be added together as a map count.
messages.period.delta: A level delta may start before this period: it is measured from the previous observed level, including time outside the game.
messages.period.summary: Statistics for the selected dates. Time intervals are clipped to the period boundaries; their start and end may differ from the original entry and exit.
messages.area_detail.eligible: Used for mean and median: {complete}; excluded: {excluded}
messages.area_detail.duration_note: Mean and median use fully measured visits without clipping or diverging continuations. Known portions of other visits remain in total time. Zero duration is distinct from unknown duration.
messages.area_detail.days_note: Visits are grouped by entry date, or exit date if the entry is unknown. Each visit appears once with its measured time within the selected period. Visits crossing midnight are not split in this table; use the calendar day link for time within each day.
messages.area_detail.chart_note: Each point is a visit: dates horizontally, minutes vertically. Hollow points indicate incomplete, clipped or branched visits. Records without a date or measured duration remain in the table. Select a point to jump to its visit.
messages.area_detail.no_chart: No visits with a known date and measured duration.
messages.comparison.title: Period comparison
messages.comparison.intro: Differences show B − A; percentage changes are relative to A. Share differences are expressed in percentage points. An increase does not necessarily mean an improvement.
messages.comparison.overlap: The periods overlap. Shared observations belong to each period independently; do not add the two periods together.
messages.comparison.missing: A dash means the calculation is unavailable because the denominator or measured data is missing. Percentage change is undefined when A is zero. No logged observations do not prove that no play occurred.
messages.comparison.method: Days follow the log time zone calendar, including days without records; durations use UTC and account for DST. Measured intervals are clipped to the selected dates. Copies and incomplete intervals follow the main report methodology. Characters and detailed report pages refer to B; source history remains complete.
messages.comparison.metrics_note: Observed maps include instances started before the period. New maps are counted by their first entry; returns are shown separately. Maps per day and hour use new entries only; hourly rates use all observed playtime, including hideouts. Mean duration follows mapping pace rules: fully measured instances without clipping, branches, incomplete identity or visits across sessions. Return visits are summed; time outside the map is excluded. Known seconds from excluded maps remain in total map time. Both rates use the same number of new maps. The second divides it by observed time minus marked AFK. This is not clear speed. A zero denominator is shown as a dash. AFK runs from its ON message to OFF or the observation boundary. Time without an AFK flag does not prove active play. Log silence and window focus loss alone do not count as AFK.
messages.comparison.zones_note: Shares use measured time with a known area as the denominator. Groups do not overlap; Other areas completes the total. Loading time and intervals with unknown location are not added to these shares.
messages.comparison.mechanics: Share of maps with an observation
messages.comparison.mechanics_note: Maps with an observation are divided by the map count for this period. A shared confirmed entry counts once in every summary. Multiple tags can belong to one map; these are not mechanic completion rates.
messages.comparison.denominators: Maps in the observation summary: A — {a}, B — {b}.
messages.comparison.incomplete: Incomplete play intervals: A — {a}, B — {b}. Unmeasured area visits: A — {za}, B — {zb}.
messages.history.branch_note: The shared entry is counted once. Continuations are shown separately; confirmed shared time is not counted again. Different branches do not form a single sequence. Matching timestamps after divergence do not prove duplication.
messages.loading.note: Durations recorded by LOADING SCREEN within the selected period. Shared log copies are counted once. Loading time is not added to the existing playtime total.
messages.loading.chart_hint: Each point is one load. Hover or focus a point to see its date, area and duration. Select it to open the original log line.
messages.loading.area_note: Areas are grouped by the exact name in each message and sorted by total loading time. Mean and median are rounded to milliseconds; individual loads retain their original precision.
messages.loading.top_note: Showing the {count} slowest loads. Equal durations keep log line order.
messages.loading.session_note: The message timestamp determines the date in the report time zone. Its entire duration belongs to that day. Session membership follows source line ranges; unconfirmed membership is shown separately.
messages.loading.undated_note: Undated loads: {count}. They are included in the tables but not on the time axis.
messages.loading.no_dates: No loads with a known date.
messages.loading.empty: No loading duration messages in the selected period.
messages.loading.pdf_note: Summary: up to 15 areas with the highest total loading time. All areas, individual loads, days and sessions are available in HTML.
messages.pace.intro: New map entry pace, time spent in maps and gaps between visits within the selected period.
messages.pace.rate_note: Maps per hour = first entries into new instances / observed playtime, including hideout and other areas. Returns do not add new maps. Time is split at local midnight; each first entry belongs to its day. Pace is undefined when playtime is zero. Baseline markers also let you select days without a rate.
messages.pace.duration_note: Mean, median and range use the time of all visits to one instance, excluding gaps outside the map. Calculations include only fully measured, identified maps without period clipping, branches or visits across sessions. This measures time spent, not confirmed map completion. Incomplete measurements are shown separately.
messages.pace.gap_note: A gap runs from a map exit to the next map entry in the same session, including returns to the same map. Hideout and other areas use measured visits; remaining time is not assigned to an area. Sessions with divergent branches and unconfirmed boundaries are excluded. LOADING SCREEN durations are not added again.
messages.pace.eligible: Included in averages and rankings: {complete}. Excluded: {excluded}.
messages.pace.no_complete: No fully measured maps available for duration comparison.
messages.pace.gap_summary: Gaps: {count} · total time: {duration} · unassigned to an area: {missing}.
messages.pace.gap_excluded: Excluded visit pairs: {pairs}; sessions with branches: {sessions}; map visits without a confirmed session: {visits}.
messages.characters.death_note: Messages are grouped by exact name. The area describes the observing client’s context, not a confirmed location of the player who died. Unknown or ambiguous area associations remain unassigned.
messages.characters.no_deaths: No death messages for this name in the selected period.
messages.characters.death_chart_note: Crosses below the line mark the time of death messages without assigning a level. Markers cover each chart’s time range; other messages remain in the chronology below. A number beside a marker indicates multiple messages at the same instant.
messages.characters.counters_note: These are unnamed cumulative counter readings. They are not new deaths, are not added together and are not assigned to characters.
messages.characters.overview_note: Characters with recorded level-ups or death messages. Only observed events are included; missing levels are not reconstructed. Other players may appear here. Identical names are grouped: the log cannot always distinguish a recreated character.
messages.characters.overview_empty: No dated level-ups or death messages were recorded in the selected period.
messages.session_chart.title: Session timeline
messages.session_chart.hint: Areas, loading screens and events share one time axis. Hover or focus for details; select a mark to open its visit or source record. Zoom in on short spans and scroll the timeline.
messages.session_chart.loading_note: Loading screens are separate: their estimated start is the message time minus the recorded duration. Log timestamps have one-second precision. Loading can overlap areas and is not added to playtime.
messages.session_chart.unknown_note: Grey areas have no measured visit; gaps in the observation strip have no measured playtime. Visits with unknown ends are shown only as marks. Overlapping measurements and simultaneous events use separate rows; these are not new sessions.
messages.session_chart.undated: Undated, outside the chart: {count}. Source records remain in the report.
messages.session_chart.unallocated: Playtime without a measured area: {duration}. Coloured shares use total area time; loading durations are not subtracted separately.
messages.explorer.title: Map selection and comparison
messages.explorer.intro: Select maps by first entry date, type and observations. Each row is one map instance; expand it for return visits.
messages.explorer.method: Date filters select instances by first entry, including entries before the report period when their visits are present in this report. They do not clip durations again: time is already limited to the report period. Unknown dates and durations are excluded only by the respective filter. Selection does not change other pages or the PDF.
messages.explorer.mechanics_note: Level is the logged area level, not map tier. A mechanic marker confirms an observation; no marker does not prove the mechanic was absent. Loading times are not added to duration.
messages.explorer.no_js: Filtering and comparison require JavaScript. All instances and the overall summary remain available below.
messages.explorer.name: Name
messages.explorer.invalid: Check the range: start must not follow end; durations must be nonnegative and minimum must not exceed maximum.
messages.explorer.sample_note: Mean, median and range use only eligible complete measurements. Known time from other maps remains in the total. Consider the measurement counts when comparing results; groups may overlap.
messages.explorer.bins_note: Both groups use the same duration bins; bars show counts of complete measurements. The left bound is inclusive, the right bound is inclusive only in the last bin.
messages.day_overview.title: Day overview
messages.day_overview.note: Sessions show their overall bounds and time on this day separately. Midnight does not start a new session. Loading is counted on the message date and is not added to playtime. Events belong to the client log and do not establish character ownership.
messages.afk.title: Time breakdown and AFK
messages.afk.note: AFK runs from its ON message to OFF or the observation boundary. Time without an AFK flag does not prove active play. Log silence and window focus loss alone do not count as AFK.
messages.afk.zone_note: Categories partition all observed time, including AFK. Unknown visit boundaries leave time unassigned to an area. Loading time is not added separately.
messages.afk.interval_note: Segments are split at area, period and shared-copy boundaries. Links lead to original evidence, which may be outside the selected period. End of file or a gap does not mean AFK was turned off.
messages.afk.rate_note: Both rates use the same number of new maps. The second divides it by observed time minus marked AFK. This is not clear speed. A zero denominator is shown as a dash.
messages.afk.share_note: Each coloured bar shows the AFK share within its category.
messages.comparison.maps_per_hour_without_afk: Maps per hour excluding marked AFK
messages.weekly.chart.rate_without_afk: New maps per hour excluding marked AFK
messages.weekly.afk_note: Both pace charts use the same scale. For a selected map type, both denominators still cover all playtime in the week; only explicitly marked AFK is excluded.
messages.time_mode.label: Time shown in charts
messages.time_mode.note: This mode changes the daily chart and the heatmap below. Dates, hour scales and colour scales are shared. Only marked AFK is excluded; the remaining time does not necessarily mean active play. Empty days are retained.
messages.heatmap.afk_note: When excluding AFK, each hour loses only its exact overlap with marked intervals. Area filters use AFK linked to measured visits. A day with no remaining time is not included in the cell’s day count.
messages.map_duration.label: Map duration
messages.map_duration.note: The mode changes the means, medians, rankings and unusually long maps below. The same completeness rules apply; excluding AFK also requires its intervals to be matched to the measured visit.
messages.map_duration.method: Only marked AFK matched to this visit is subtracted from measured time. Return visits to the same instance are added together. Unknown parts are not inferred; a dash means AFK cannot be matched precisely. Time without an AFK flag does not prove active play.
messages.map_duration.explorer_note: One mode applies to both groups: duration filters, sorting, totals, means, medians and distributions change together. Unknown remaining time is excluded from duration calculations. Other filters are preserved.
messages.outliers.intro: Compare with other instances of the same area type and level within the report period. The largest time differences from the median come first.
messages.outliers.method: Each map needs at least {peers} other complete measurements with the same area ID and level. The map being checked is excluded from its own median. A duration is flagged when it reaches at least {factor} times the median and exceeds it by at least {seconds} seconds. Each mode recalculates its sample and median. Incomplete, clipped or branched maps, unknown or ambiguous levels and unknown remaining durations are excluded. A zero median has no percentage difference; measured zeros are retained. This measures presence, not confirmed completion.
messages.outliers.context_note: Returns, AFK, death messages and mechanic observations provide context. Coinciding events do not prove why a map took longer; a missing message does not prove an event was absent.
messages.outliers.summary: Flagged: {found} · compared: {compared} · too few peers: {insufficient} · excluded: {excluded}.
messages.outliers.context: Context: {returns} returns · {deaths} death messages · {mechanics} mechanic observations
messages.outliers.gap_note: Only confirmed gaps between consecutive visits to this instance within one linear session are shown. Time outside the map is not added to its duration.
messages.outliers.none: No comparable maps exceed these thresholds.
messages.outliers.samples: Samples by area type and level
messages.outliers.sample_note: The table lists eligible measurements. Each map requires {peers} other instances in the same row for comparison. Matching names with different area IDs remain separate.
messages.outliers.no_groups: No eligible measurements with a known area type and a consistent area level.
messages.session_compare.title: Session comparison
messages.session_compare.intro: Choose two sessions. Values and the B − A difference update in this report.
messages.session_compare.rate: New maps per hour of selected time
messages.session_compare.median: Median map duration in selected mode
messages.session_compare.gap: Confirmed gap time in selected mode
messages.session_compare.same: The same session is selected twice. Choose different sessions to compare.
messages.session_compare.empty: At least two observed sessions are required for comparison.
messages.session_compare.no_js: Choosing A/B requires JavaScript. Each session is available through the links below.
messages.session_compare.types: Matching map types and area levels
messages.session_compare.types_note: Rows match by area ID and a consistent known area level. Each cell shows the median and counts of complete and excluded instances. A dash means no sample; zero is a measured value. One instance is too small a sample for conclusions.
messages.session_compare.ungrouped: Without an unambiguous type or level: {count}.
messages.session_compare.method: New maps use first entries; returns belong to the session of their visit. Medians use only complete identified instances without clipping, branches or visits across sessions. The time mode changes the pace denominator and map and gap durations. Overall playtime, AFK and area time remain unchanged. Time without marked AFK does not prove active play.
messages.session_compare.evidence_note: Counts reflect log records. Only confirmed gaps are shown; no measurements do not prove no gaps occurred. Death messages may concern other players. Outliers use peers from the entire report period, not only the selected pair. Events are not treated as causes of delays.
messages.session_compare.timeline_note: Both timelines use the same seconds per division from the start of observations in the selected period. The shorter session ends earlier; empty space after it is not playtime. Tooltips retain actual dates. Zoom and scrolling are shared.
messages.loading_routes.summary: Loading records: {count}. Known source: {known}; unknown source: {unknown}.
messages.loading_routes.method: A route joins two consecutive area entries within one source file. A loading record matches only the latest entry with the exact same name; that entry must fall within the recorded loading duration with a 1 s allowance for timestamp precision. Each entry matches at most one loading record. Disconnects, log openings, clock rollback and gaps over 30 minutes reset context. Shared copies are counted once and distinct continuations separately. Durations come only from LOADING SCREEN and are not added again to playtime.
messages.loading_routes.p95_note: P95 is the observed value at position ceil(0.95 × N) in the sorted sample, without interpolation. With fewer than 20 records it is close to the maximum; sample sizes are shown. Zero durations are included. No loading records do not imply zero waiting time.
messages.loading_routes.chart_note: Median and P95 for each day with measurements. Days without records remain empty. Click a bar to open its day row; the date in the table opens the calendar. The full duration belongs to the day of its message.
messages.loading_routes.reason.no_entry: No unambiguous entry for this load
messages.loading_routes.reason.different_area: Loading area does not match the latest entry
messages.loading_routes.reason.outside_loading: Latest entry is outside the loading interval
messages.stability.title: Game stability
messages.stability.scope: Summary for the selected report period. The full message history remains below.
messages.stability.method: These are observed technical messages, not a count of proven failures. End of file, normal exit and exception-handler registration are not crashes. Warnings and reading errors are separate. Copied log prefixes are counted once.
messages.stability.context_note: Area and nearest load are linked within each source file. A load must be within 60 seconds before or after the message, without crossing a session boundary, a gap over 30 minutes or a clock rollback; ties prefer the preceding load. Distinct continuations may provide several links. The area may be unknown during a transition. Nearby events do not prove causation.
messages.stability.series_note: A series groups consecutive technical messages with the same code, category, severity, text and continuations, at most 60 seconds apart. Transitions, boundaries, different dates and branches split series. Undated records are not grouped. Every source record remains available.
messages.stability.chart_note: Bar height is the message count; colours indicate categories. Click to open day details. Gaps without messages do not prove that no failures occurred.
messages.stability.undated: Undated messages: {count}. They remain in the list without a chart point.
messages.stability.no_loading: No nearby load confirmed within 60 seconds.
messages.stability.empty: No technical messages found in the selected period.
messages.stability.history_note: All messages from the loaded history, including records outside the selected period.
messages.map_run.title: Map run
messages.map_run.type: All runs of this map type
messages.map_run.navigation_note: Adjacent maps follow the order of first entries in the same session; navigation is omitted for forks or runs spanning multiple sessions.
messages.map_run.method: This page combines visits to one reconstructed map instance within the selected report period. Incomplete boundaries, clipping and divergent continuations remain visible; zero differs from unknown time.
messages.map_run.context_note: Events are linked through source visits, entries and loading records, not matching clocks in different files. Death messages may refer to another character; nearby errors do not prove a cause of delay.
messages.map_run.comparison_note: Median of other complete runs with the same area ID and level in the selected period. This run is excluded; at least {count} peers are required. Each duration mode has its own sample.
messages.map_run.compare_excluded: Measurement is not eligible for comparison
messages.map_run.gap_note: From a confirmed exit to the next entry into this instance, within one session without forks. Includes time in the hideout and other intermediate areas. AFK is already included in the duration.
messages.map_run.gap_unknown: Duration is unconfirmed: missing boundary, fork or different sessions.
messages.map_run.no_gaps: No gaps between visits in the selected period.
messages.map_run.loading_note: Loading records for entries into and exits from this instance, confirmed by source links. They are not added to playtime.
messages.map_run.issue_note: Technical messages whose confirmed area belongs to this visit. Each record links to the full diagnostics.
messages.map_run.timeline_note: An unknown exit is shown as an entry marker only. Empty intervals are not reconstructed; overlapping continuations use separate lanes.
messages.run_compare.title: Map run comparison
messages.run_compare.intro: Choose two runs from the report period to compare time, returns and recorded events.
messages.run_compare.empty: At least two map runs are needed for comparison.
messages.run_compare.same: The same run is selected on both sides. Choose another run to compare.
messages.run_compare.unknown_identity: The area type or a single area level is unconfirmed for at least one side.
messages.run_compare.differences: Difference is B − A; percentage is relative to A. A zero baseline has no defined percentage.
messages.run_compare.timeline_note: Zero marks the first entry into each run. Both timelines share a time scale and scroll together. Loading before entry appears left of zero. Hover or focus for actual dates; select a mark to open the visit or source record.
messages.run_compare.events_note: Recorded observations include mechanics, discoveries, mercenaries, death messages and technical issues. Zero means no recorded message, not proof that an event did not occur. Timing alone does not establish a cause.
messages.run_compare.no_js: JavaScript is required to select A/B. All run cards remain available below.
messages.run_compare.no_timeline: There is not enough timing data for a timeline from the first entry. Available records remain in the run card.
messages.run_compare.method: Metrics come from the cards for the selected period. Incomplete, clipped and branched measurements retain their flags; their differences do not compare complete clears. Any unknown gap leaves total gap time and gap AFK unknown. Loading is not added to map time; AFK is already included in duration. Timelines retain real gaps, time offsets and blank spans outside the period slice.
messages.overview.title: Period overview
messages.overview.no_time: No measured playtime in this period.
messages.overview.partial_total: Incomplete intervals: {count}. Only measured time is shown.
messages.overview.day_new: Most new maps in a day
messages.overview.day_loading_share: Highest loading ratio in a day
messages.overview.session_new: Most new maps in a session
messages.overview.session_loading_share: Highest loading ratio in a session
messages.overview.highlights_note: New maps are counted at first entry; returns are excluded. The loading ratio is total LOADING SCREEN duration divided by observed playtime. It is not added to playtime; short or incomplete intervals may yield more than 100%.
messages.overview.no_maps: No map visits in this period.
messages.overview.popular_note: Up to three types by the number of runs touched by the period. Visits include returns.
messages.overview.gap_mean: Mean confirmed gap between map visits
messages.overview.comparison_note: Map pace is per hour of playtime; loading time is per calendar day. Map duration is the mean of complete runs. Gaps include returns, are clipped to the period and require confirmed boundaries within one session. A difference does not imply a cause or an improvement.
messages.overview.gap_sample: Gaps A/B: {a}/{b} · Excluded pairs: {ea}/{eb} · Visits without a session: {ua}/{ub}.
messages.overview.method: Distribution segments add up to observed playtime. AFK is included in those segments. Unassigned time is shown separately. Highlights use positive measured values; ties show the earliest date. The overview preserves the period, incomplete-data flags and log merging rules.
messages.observation_analytics.title: Observation analytics
messages.observation_analytics.note: Durations cover the entire map, not the mechanic itself. Group differences do not establish a cause of delay. Named death messages may refer to other characters.
messages.observation_analytics.method: Shares use all selected map instances, including incomplete ones. Means and medians follow the common pace rules: incomplete, clipped, branched, unidentified and multiple-session instances are excluded. The mode without marked AFK also excludes unknown remaining time. Comparisons require the same area ID and one known level across all visits. Median differences require at least {minimum} eligible maps in each group. Sample sizes and exclusions remain visible; these are descriptive comparisons without causal or statistical-significance claims.
messages.observation_analytics.unmatched: Observed maps without an unambiguous type or level: {count}. They contribute to the share but are not matched.
messages.observation_analytics.trend_note: Dates use the selected instance’s first entry in the report timezone. Returns do not create new maps. Days without the marker are retained; a zero denominator is shown as a dash.
messages.observation_analytics.comparison: Comparison by matching type and level
messages.observation_analytics.sample_note: Counts show eligible / all instances in each group. Medians describe the available sample; a difference requires at least {minimum} eligible maps on each side.
messages.observation_analytics.samples: Maps in both samples and exclusions
messages.observation_analytics.unknown_afk: Remaining time without AFK is unknown
messages.observation_analytics.no_maps: There are no maps in this group.
messages.observation_analytics.no_groups: No maps have an unambiguous type and level for matching.
messages.analytics.title: Analytics
messages.rhythm.method: 30-minute bins anchored to the original session start, including period selections. Seconds are split in UTC; only measured intervals count. AFK requires a recorded toggle; hideout time and gaps may include AFK and must not be added to it. Bins with no observations are not filled.
messages.rhythm.change: New maps/hour in the first and second halves of the displayed bins
messages.rhythm.streak_method: Consecutive first entries into fully measured maps in one linear session. The confirmed gap must not exceed 5 minutes. Marked or unknown AFK, returns, clipping or incomplete measurements interrupt a streak. Single-map streaks are retained.
messages.rhythm.empty: No measured sessions in the selected period.
messages.combinations.method: Sets contain only recorded mechanic markers. Repeated dialogue and returns do not count a map twice. An absent marker does not prove an absent mechanic; co-occurrence does not prove completion or an effect on duration.
messages.combinations.sample_method: Groups use the exact area ID and a consistent known level. The reference set has the most eligible measurements, with code order breaking ties. A median difference requires at least {minimum} measurements in each set. Small groups remain visible; no causal relationship is implied.
messages.trading.method: Accepted and cancelled exchanges are counted from explicit client messages. They do not reveal the exchanged items, counterpart or revenue. Dates use the report time zone; unknown dates and sessions are shown separately.
messages.trading.requests_note: Requests match supported English and Russian purchase templates only. They are messages, not completed trades. Other whispers in this period: {count}; these are not classified as trade messages. Full conversations remain available in Conversations.
messages.trading.between_note: Counts first map entries between consecutive accepted exchanges in the same session and continuous ledger segment. Returns are excluded. An appended source boundary does not join exchanges from different continuations.
messages.trading.gaps_note: Shows measured map gaps containing exchanges or template requests. The entire gap is not classified as trading time; other activities may have occurred.
messages.trading.no_gaps: No trade events in confirmed map gaps.
messages.trading.empty: No trade events in the selected period.
messages.consistency.method: Each group uses one area ID and a consistent known level. The full run duration belongs to the week of its original first entry (Monday in the report time zone), even if it ended later. Clipped, incomplete, ambiguous and cross-session runs follow the shared exclusion rules.
messages.consistency.quantiles: Quartiles use linear interpolation at position (n−1)×p in the sorted sample. Known zero durations are retained. Unknown remaining time is excluded in the AFK-adjusted mode. Samples below five measurements are marked small; changes do not imply improved skill.
messages.consistency.legend: Whiskers: minimum–maximum; box: middle 50% (Q1–Q3); line: median. Dashes indicate a small sample. Weeks in each group and mode share one scale.
messages.recovery.method: Interval from a recorded disconnect to the first subsequent area-entry message in the same source file. This is an observed gap, not measured server downtime or connection recovery time. Proven prefixes remove copies; divergent continuations remain separate.
messages.recovery.long_note: Intervals longer than 30 minutes are marked as long breaks. These, divergent continuations, clock regressions and unknown boundaries are excluded from the median of short observations. Adjacent files and equal timestamps do not prove a return.
messages.recovery.outside: Entry outside the selected period; shown as context
messages.recovery.empty: No disconnects in the selected period.
messages.consistency.unmatched: Maps without an unambiguous area ID, level or entry date: {count}. They are excluded from the weekly groups.
messages.measure.partial: Time coverage is incomplete or ambiguous; excluded from the median.
messages.measure.empty: No eligible observations in the selected period.
messages.measure.overlap_note: AFK is part of measured playtime and may overlap any area. It is not added to map or gap time. Unknown area time is shown separately.
messages.cycles.method: A cycle starts at the first entry into a new map instance and ends at the next first entry in the same linear session. Returns, other maps and areas remain inside the cycle. Only proven measurements count; period clipping and incomplete coverage are excluded from means and medians. A cycle does not imply map completion.
messages.cycles.omitted: Without a next map: {open}. Ambiguous pairs skipped: {skipped}. Without a confirmed session: {unassigned}.
messages.focus.method: Intervals follow Lost/Gained focus messages in one source file. A repeated Lost does not move the start. The observed focus-loss interval and its intersection with measured playtime are shown separately. Loss of focus is not classified as AFK.
messages.focus.unknown_note: An ending is not inferred at EOF, observation gaps, restarts, disconnects, clock regressions or unknown timestamps. Divergent continuations are not averaged. Period clipping retains the measured part but excludes it from the median of full intervals.
messages.focus.state.boundary: Session boundary without a focus gain
messages.focus.state.unmatched_gain: Focus gain without a recorded loss
messages.remaining.method: Each map shows its last recorded /remaining value in the selected period and all source messages. A recorded zero does not prove that monsters did not appear later or that the map was completed. No message means an unknown value. No last value is selected across divergent continuations; messages outside confirmed maps are listed separately.
messages.remaining.denominator: Share denominator: {count} maps with an unambiguous observation.
messages.remaining.types: By exact area ID and consistent known level
messages.returns.method: Returns are counted from original repeated entries in the selected period. First and subsequent visit time is split using measured parts of the period, including entries that continued from before it. Incomplete measurements remain separate from medians; the reason for a return is not inferred.
messages.returns.routes: Between visits to the same map instance
messages.returns.route_note: Routes use original entries from one linear session. Measured time is restricted to the period; route links preserve context. A missing measurement is not replaced with zero.
messages.edges.method: Boundaries come from the original observed session and do not move to the selected period start. Segments before the first map visit, after the last, and whole sessions without maps are measured. These are not client startup time or proven preparation time. EOF and other incomplete endings are excluded from medians; measured parts and incompleteness reasons remain visible.
messages.edges.counts: Original sessions without maps: {empty}. Ambiguous sessions: {branched}.
messages.edges.state.no_maps: No map visits in the original session
messages.obstacles.method: Counts explicit messages about insufficient space, full stash tabs, unavailable portals, locked passages and failed item use. Area context is established in each source before merging. These messages are not automatically classified as technical failures.
messages.obstacles.series_note: Repeats follow proven predecessors of the same message type in the same area, at most 60 seconds apart. Transitions, gaps, clock regressions or source boundaries do not create links. Divergent series preserve all messages without a single duration.
messages.obstacles.span: Between the first and last messages
messages.obstacles.gaps: Confirmed map gaps containing these messages
messages.obstacles.gaps_note: A message inside a gap does not prove it caused the entire delay. Gap duration is not treated as time spent resolving the obstacle.
messages.markers.method: Intervals run between first entries into maps with a recorded marker: new maps strictly between them and measured playtime. Returns do not add a new map. Links remain within a linear session; unknown map identity breaks the sequence. An absent record does not prove an absent mechanic; the true appearance probability is not estimated.
messages.markers.boundaries: Marker-free runs at the start or end of an observed sequence are censored: the previous or next observation is unknown. These are shown separately from complete intervals. Sessions and independent sources are not joined by timestamps.
messages.markers.observed: In sequences: {count}; marked maps in total: {total}
messages.markers.longest: Longest observed run without a record
messages.observations.small: Fewer than 20 samples: nearest-rank P95 may equal the maximum. This is the distribution of recorded observations.
messages.observations.outside: Original observation outside the selected period
messages.observations.elapsed: Observed interval within the selected period
messages.network.method: Recorded instance connection times and other connections are shown separately. These are not continuous ping measurements. P95 uses nearest rank. Resyncing is counted as a message without assigning a unit to its value; proximity to a disconnect does not establish a cause. Area and session context comes only from the source file.
messages.passives.method: Only recorded passive allocations and removals, mastery selections and GoldCost values are shown. The difference between operations is not the allocated point count of a complete tree. Build ownership is not inferred; GoldCost does not prove gold was spent. Repeated messages remain observations.
messages.marker_timing.method: Time runs from the original first map entry to the first recorded marker, including intervening departures. Time since the start of that visit is shown separately. This is not when a mechanic spawned, started or completed. Period selection preserves the original first marker; branches do not receive a single first message. Medians use the shared measurement exclusions; types match exact area IDs and levels.
messages.marker_timing.types: By matching map type and level
messages.routes.method: Adjacent pairs and triples of entries are established within one source. Gaps, process changes and clock reversals break a route. Time is measured between the first and last entries, excluding time after the last. An A → B → A loop of area types differs from returning to the same reconstructed instance. Frequent routes are not labelled unnecessary actions. The final entry selects the period; measured time is clipped to its boundaries, with branches and incomplete coverage excluded from medians.
messages.trade_api.method: Requests and responses are linked by request_id within one source process before logs are merged. A reused pending ID and divergent continuations remain ambiguous. API types and error codes retain their original values without guessing their meanings. A missing response does not prove an error or timeout. Duration comes from the recorded took value rather than second-resolution timestamps. Requests select the period; orphan responses use response time, and endings outside the period are labelled. This does not confirm a trade with a player.
messages.level_progress.method: Level messages are compared using exact character names and classes within one continuous source. Only consecutive levels enter the summary; gaps, repeats and alternatives are labelled. Elapsed time is separate from measured client time and AFK. Client time is not attributed to that character, and death messages do not determine experience loss. The ending message selects the period; measured time is clipped, with incomplete and clipped pairs excluded from medians.
messages.presence.method: Source joined/left pairs describe observed presence in the client area context. Repeated joined messages do not move the start. Transitions, gaps, EOF and process changes do not replace left messages; divergent continuations are retained. Complete pairs intersect the period, while unknown endings are not invented. Message counts differ from pair counts. Observed duration does not prove party membership, trading or character activity.
messages.memory.method: Used, OsUsed and Total snapshots retain their original units. Statistics and changes are calculated separately for each unit; a unit change leaves the difference unknown. The preceding snapshot comes from the same continuous source, including before the selected period. Values between records are unknown; these are neither continuous RSS measurements nor a leak diagnosis.
messages.startup.method: Stage durations use the recorded seconds and are not added: stages may be nested. A separate interval starts at the first STARTUP or ENGINE Init marker and ends at the first area entry. This is time between markers, not full process startup time. Gaps, EOF and alternative continuations remain explicit; the first marker selects the period and clipped intervals are excluded from the summary.
messages.environment.method: Samples are separated by recorded engine version, revision, API and driver. Loads are grouped by exact destination name and connections by proven area ID and level; different sample kinds and units remain separate. Issue counts are normalized by observed environment time between records in a continuous source, excluding copied time. Sample sizes and missing metadata are explicit. Differences describe observations and do not establish causation.
messages.environment.incomplete: Metadata is incomplete: this group is not considered fully comparable.
messages.acquisitions.method: Only explicitly recorded identifications and artifact additions are counted; each artifact type is summed separately. Bestiary values count messages; the number of creatures is unknown. Maps use source area-entry evidence; events elsewhere and unknown context remain separate. These observations do not value items or represent complete loot.
messages.milestones.method: Chronology of recorded rewards, point counters and Steam achievements. Intervals join consecutive markers in a continuous source; the end selects the period and the predecessor is retained. Wall time and measured client time are separate and branches remain marked. Repeats remain messages. /played and character-age snapshots are neither summed nor assigned to an assumed owner; markers do not prove a complete campaign run.
messages.coverage.method: Primary datasets of the other 28 analytics are shown: events, samples, maps, sessions or intervals. Eligibility refers to the stated dataset: counting recorded messages, complete measurements under the page rules, or metadata and destination for environment samples. Mechanics and weekly consistency audit map-duration datasets. Unknown context, missing dates, clipping and ambiguity are independent flags and may overlap. Zero does not prove source completeness; this does not estimate all missing game events. A dash means that the projection does not provide an assessment of that flag.
messages.memory.plot: Each point is a recorded snapshot; values between points are not interpolated.
messages.environment.minimum: The same destinations and sample kinds are compared with complete recorded environments. The median difference requires five samples on each side; it is descriptive and does not establish causation.
messages.pool.method: New instances whose first entry is in the selected period are counted. Shares use maps with a recorded ID; unknown types are separate. Weeks start on Monday in the report zone and compare with the preceding represented week, without assuming data for missing weeks. Same-ID streaks require proven linear sessions; returns add no new map and uncertain identity breaks a streak.
messages.marker_order.method: Pairs and triples of adjacent recorded mechanic, discovery and mercenary markers within one map instance. Repeated messages remain; the last marker selects the period and the original predecessor is retained. Alternative continuations receive no shared ordering. Wall time, measured client time and marked AFK are separate; intervals spanning returns may include other areas. This measures message order, not encounter durations.
messages.cards.title: Drawn divination cards
messages.cards.method: Each exact Card drawn from the deck message adds one observation under its original card name. Frequencies describe recorded messages only, with days, sessions and proven areas. Actual odds and item values are not inferred.
messages.cards.name: Name
messages.fault.method: Intervals are separate for disconnects, client errors, warnings and crash messages. Measured time uses proven segments of the same source path, including multiple sessions; AFK is separate. New maps are counted strictly between endpoints. Leading/trailing segments, gaps, process and clock changes censor observations; silence does not prove absence of faults. The period clips intervals; censored and ambiguous intervals are excluded from medians. Categories can overlap and their times are not added.
messages.fault.left: Left endpoint is censored by the start of observations.
messages.fault.right: Right endpoint is censored by the end of observations.
messages.filters.method: Chronology of downloads, hash announcements, saves and reloads. Saved and successfully reloaded versions are compared separately by ID in one continuous source. A failed reload does not replace the last confirmed version. A preceding record outside the period is retained; no preceding version means a first observation. HTTP statuses and messages remain original.
messages.basic.daily_hint: Labels show hours and minutes. Long periods are grouped by week: select a weekly bar to see its days. Adjust the dates and zoom as needed.
messages.basic.hours_axis: Hours on the vertical axis, dates on the horizontal axis.
messages.basic.time_note: Shows playtime measured from the logs, including recorded AFK. Gaps without observations are not counted as playtime.
messages.basic.area_note: A bar shows a measured visit; a translucent mark shows an entry with unknown duration. A dash means the time is unknown.
messages.basic.mechanics_note: Share of maps with each exact combination of recorded mechanics. These are log observations, not confirmed completions.
messages.basic.maps_note: Shares use new maps with a known type, as in the map pool. Time includes measured visits and returns; it is not clear time.
messages.basic.unknown_maps: Maps with an unknown type: {count}. They are excluded from shares.
messages.basic.empty: No data for the selected period.
messages.basic.character_note: Charts show recorded levels. Crosses indicate death messages for that name; they do not necessarily refer to the log owner.
messages.intensity.title: When you play during the week
messages.intensity.note: Seven weekdays, from midnight on the left to the end of the day on the right. Warmer, brighter colours mean more playtime around that time. Smooth shading covers half an hour on either side; totals on the right use exact logged intervals, including marked AFK.
messages.intensity.scale: One scale for the whole week: 00:00:00 to {maximum} played within a one-hour window. Colour is a smoothed estimate, not additional playtime.
